statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-31900 affects the Black GitHub Action when use_pyproject: true reads an attacker-controlled pyproject.toml direct URL dependency. The datahub-ingestion image does not include or execute the Black GitHub Action, and the black package itself is not installed in the image. The SBOM entry is a false positive sourced from the acryl_great_expectations 0.15.50.1 METADATA file, which lists black[jupyter]==22.3.0 only behind the test extra. The runtime install does not request that extra, so no black module or dist-info exists on disk and no Black action code can execute.

CVE-2026-31900 affects black's GitHub action configuration parsing (fixed in black 26.3.0). As with CVE-2024-21503 and CVE-2026-32274 in this file, black 22.3.0 is an SBOM false positive: acryl-datahub declares it in a dev-only extra, but the package is NOT installed in any variant. Verified on the built dhi/datahub-actions:1.5.0.7-debian13 and 1.5.0.7-debian13-dev images: no black distribution exists under /opt/datahub/lib/python3.10/site-packages and no /opt/datahub/bin/black entry point exists. The vulnerable GitHub action code cannot execute because black itself is not present.

CVE-2024-21503 is a ReDoS in black's lines.py (fixed in black 24.3.0), triggerable only when black formats crafted source code. As with CVE-2026-32274 in this file, black 22.3.0 is an SBOM false positive: acryl-datahub declares it in a dev-only extra, but the package is NOT installed in any variant. Verified on the built dhi/datahub-actions:1.5.0.7-debian13 and 1.5.0.7-debian13-full images: no black distribution exists under /opt/datahub/lib/python3.10/site-packages and no /opt/datahub/bin/black entry point exists. The vulnerable formatter cannot execute because black itself is not present.

SBOM false-positive: black 22.3.0 is listed in /opt/docker/sbom/datahub-actions/.spdx.datahub-actions.json because acryl-datahub declares it in a dev-only extra, but the package is NOT installed in any variant. Verified: `pip show black` returns 'Package(s) not found' on the dhi/datahub-actions:1-dev image; `find /opt -name 'black*'` returns only /opt/datahub/lib/python3.10/site-packages/datahub/ingestion/sink/blackhole.py (datahub's no-op metadata sink, unrelated to the black formatter). The vulnerable code path (black formatting a maliciously-named source file with path traversal) cannot execute because black itself is not present.

Verified: `pip show black` returns 'Package(s) not found' on the dhi/datahub-actions:1-dev image; `find /opt -name 'black*'` returns only /opt/datahub/lib/python3.10/site-packages/datahub/ingestion/sink/blackhole.py (datahub's no-op metadata sink, unrelated to the black formatter). The vulnerable code path (black formatting a maliciously-named source file with path traversal) cannot execute because black itself is not present.

The black package is not actually installed in the datahub-ingestion image. The black entry in the SBOM is a false positive sourced from the acryl_great_expectations 0.15.50.1 METADATA file, which lists 'black[jupyter]==22.3.0' as a test-only extra (Requires-Dist: black[jupyter]==22.3.0; extra == "test"). The runtime install does not request the test extra, so no black files exist on disk and no Python module 'black' is importable. The path-traversal vulnerability requires invoking the black CLI; that code path is unreachable.

CVE-2024-21503 is a ReDoS in black's lines_with_leading_tabs_expanded function (strings.py), exploitable only by running the black formatter on attacker-controlled input. The black package is not actually installed in the datahub-ingestion image: the SBOM entry is a false positive sourced from the acryl_great_expectations 0.15.50.1 METADATA file, which lists 'black[jupyter]==22.3.0' only behind the test and dev extras (Requires-Dist: black[jupyter]==22.3.0; extra == "test"), which the runtime install never requests. Verified in the built image: no black module or dist-info exists in site-packages and `python -c "import black"` fails with ModuleNotFoundError, so the vulnerable code is not present.
